title: acSweep
body:
## acSweep

Characterise bounded ideal linear RLC networks across linear, decade or octave frequencies: native node voltages, optional native source-current/KCL checks, derived input impedance and passive branch complex power. Declare peak/RMS phasor convention and sampled gain, relative phase, current, power or loading requirements. Results retain verified CSV, circuit summary and inspectable netlist. Use for filters, source loading, resonance and resistor heating; no nonlinear or general transient claim.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- For logarithmic spacing points is nominal samples per decade/octave, not total output count; actual count must fit3–512.
- Declare peak or rms amplitude convention before interpreting power; currents are a to b and input current is -i(vdrive). Branch current is derived, whereas input current is native observed.
- Phase requirements use principal relative Vprobe/Vsource angle and refuse zero response. A bound never wraps and solver tolerance does not relax user acceptance.
- Every frequency must have a nonsingular, conditioned network; no ideal-inductor/source loops, mutual coupling, nonlinear models or continuous-envelope guarantee.

Native binding: `ngspice ac lin/dec/oct`. Output kind: `["table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `circuit` | The circuit, written inline: one ideal voltage source between ground (node "0") and the source node, 1 to 64 resistors, up to 64 capacitors, up to 64 uncoupled inductors (acSweep only) and the nodes to publish. At most 16 non-ground nodes; no netlist, device model or subcircuit can be imported. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"default":"in"},"resistors":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"required":true,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"resistance":{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0,"required":true}}}},"capacitors":{"type":"array","maxItems":64,"default":[],"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"capacitance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-12,"maximum":1,"required":true}}}},"probes":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":15,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"default":["out"]},"inductors":{"type":"array","maxItems":64,"default":[],"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"inductance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":1000.0,"required":true}}}},"branchProbes":{"type":"array","maxItems":8,"uniqueItems":true,"default":[],"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32}}}}` | **required** |
| `start` | DC start is signed source volts (default 0); AC start is positive frequency Hz (default 1). stop must exceed start. rcStep always starts at zero seconds. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0}` | `1` |
| `stop` | DC stop is source volts (default 5), AC stop is positive Hz (default 10000), RC stop is seconds (default 0.005). RC duration must be 0.01–20 R*C time constants. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0}` | `10000` |
| `points` | Sample control, default 101: for linear AC it is total frequencies including endpoints (3–512); for decade/octave it is nominal points per decade/octave and actual count must be 3–512. DC/RC use total uniform samples. Narrow resonances need appropriate density; requirements inspect only sampled points. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":3,"maximum":512}` | `101` |
| `amplitude` | Nonzero source phasor/step amplitude in volts, range -1000 to 1000, default 1. In AC amplitudeConvention explicitly interprets phasors as peak (default) or rms and controls power factor. Negative source amplitude reverses native voltage/current phasors while relative transfer phase and power remain consistent. rcStep uses the step height. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-1000,"maximum":1000}` | `1` |
| `spacing` | Frequency grid: linear (default) means points total including endpoints; decade/octave means nominal samples per frequency decade/octave. Octave and short-decade partial intervals may end below stop. Ngspice47 redistributes full-decade spans to include stop; inspect frequencyGrid.actualSamples and lastFrequency_Hz. At least 3 and at most 512 actual samples are required. Use enough density to resolve narrow features. | `{"type":"enum","values":["linear","decade","octave"]}` | `"linear"` |
| `portMetrics` | When true, save native source current and independently check -i(vdrive) against solved current and KCL before publishing $input current, derived input impedance and complex/apparent power. Default false omits these ten columns. Current enters the passive network; input impedance near zero current is undefined and rejected. Select fewer probes if the whole output exceeds 64 columns. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
| `amplitudeConvention` | Interpret all AC phasor magnitudes as peak (default) or rms. Native AC analysis supplies linear phasors without choosing physical amplitude convention. Peak uses S=V*conj(I)/2; rms uses S=V*conj(I). Switching convention preserves native voltages/currents and doubles powers. The declared convention and factor remain in the summary. | `{"type":"enum","values":["peak","rms"]}` | `"peak"` |
